name: Banking Blocks for WooCommerce
author: LokusWP

sections.description:
Banking Blocks for WooCommerce is a plugin that allows you Add More Bank Payment Options to Your Store with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks

Key Features

Local Bank Integration: 2 Local Bank, Support for major Indonesian banks (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI, CIMB Niaga), QRIS, and Dana e-wallet.
WooCommerce Checkout Blocks Compatibility: Easily add bank payment options directly to your product pages or checkout process.
User-Friendly Configuration: Simple setup and management of payment methods.

How to Use

1.Install the Plugin: Download and install the Banking Blocks for WooCommerce plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
2.Activate the Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
3.Configure Payment Methods: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments to configure your desired bank payment methods.
4.Enable Payment Method: Customize the appearance of the payment method, including its icon and name.
5.Test Your Transactions: Conduct test transactions to ensure the payment methods are functioning correctly.

If you have ideas or suggestions about features we should add, feel free to rate the plugin and ask questions in the support forum.
